scope: EVIDENCE ONLY (not native training, accepted-science evidence, merge or production)
hypothesis: Sharing only stable learned pair-relations across three sequential episodes should reduce held cold-transfer consequence loss at least 5% relative to the best directly matched fully trained stage-specific relations learner while preserving OLD and MIDDLE historical functional readouts across a fresh process restart.

dataset.origin: Self-authored synthetic causal interventions; generated from seeded numpy RNG, not native Yggdrasil or real-world data
dataset.inputs: 10 underlying independent do-action causal bits; 2 correlated observed nuisance cues subject to old/middle/new/cold context shifts. Learn only from actions and observed labeled consequences.
dataset.latent: 4 signed pair-parity primitives, stable pair relations, old-specific and middle/new edge changes; edge reversal in one family, previously unrepresented triple relation in another. Hidden truth reserved for evaluator.
dataset.interventions: Exactly 508 distinct causal assignment identities (84 OLD training +84 MIDDLE training +84 NEW training +64 each held OLD/MIDDLE/NEW/COLD); no duplicate causal 10-bit do-action between phases.
dataset.labels: Every fitted arm receives the identical 252 observed intervention consequences (84 per episode) and the same action observations. Ground-truth planted supports/weights and all 256 held labeled outcomes withheld during fitting.
dataset.features: Candidate/structurally matched controls use 4 pair-parity primitive supports chosen by standard OMP on OLD factual labels and six pair products. Conventional full-basis ElasticNet receives 1..4 Walsh features, RBF KernelRidge receives raw 12 bits. Feature grammar is preauthored, NOT discovered operator language.
dataset.family_cases: 3 family types ×4 world ids ×3 independent seed clusters; cold nuisance bits independent of causal variables.

arms.candidate: cumulative_invariants: fit OLD OMP4 primitive supports; fit separate OLD/MIDDLE/NEW Ridge graph heads; identify shared edges from 3 episode training coefficients (abs>=.18, same sign, coefficient range<=.35). Fit stage-gated pooled Ridge alpha=.4 where shared edge coefficients are tied across 3 episodes and all other coefficients/biases stage-specific. Save all OLD/MIDDLE heads unchanged; NEW and COLD use final cumulative head.
arms.matched_control: separate_relations: same old OMP4 primitive supports, independent Ridge alpha=.4 on NEW facts; OLD and MIDDLE separate heads restored unchanged. Same observed 252 examples and same 10 graph features. Conventional legitimate capacity/budget match, no oracle.
strong_controls: rehearsal_ridge: stage-indicator pooled regression on 3 episodes with NO invariant-shared edges; same graph features and full witness history
shared_all: unconditional tie of all six edge coefficients
full_elasticnet: full 1..4 Walsh basis per episode, alpha=.04,l1_ratio=.82,max_iter=1400,tol=.0005
rbf_kernel: separate RBF kernel ridge on all 12 action bits alpha=.15 gamma=.30
no_update: OLD and MIDDLE historical readouts, MIDDLE head used unchanged for NEW/COLD
shuffled_new: NEW labels shuffled before latest-stage fitting, same observed inputs
arms.sequential_memory: Candidate reports old and middle frozen historical readouts and NEW/COLD final readout from JSON checkpoint. It is a multi-head episode-tagged design: preserving old functionality does not prove a single live mutable network can answer unknown epoch queries.
arms.cold_restart: For each case, spawn an isolated new Python -I process executing standard-library-only restore.py from serialized checkpoint JSON and held input actions. Compare OLD/MIDDLE/NEW/COLD readouts with original model predictions at atol 1e-11. No outcome labels passed to restore.py.
arms.compute: One 36-world primary, one unchanged-source replay and independent full refit audit; 36 fresh-process restart checks per primary. Single-thread Linux CPU Python3.13.5 NumPy2.3.5 SciPy1.17.0 scikit-learn1.8.0, exact source hashes; no paid APIs, native Yggdrasil runner, or protected first-use.
arms.evaluation: Held MSE per old, middle, new and cold context (64 held outcomes/context/world) plus per-seed and per-family cold transfer; deterministic non-timing semantic replay exact SHA256; independent generator, checkpoint and all arms refit; serialized checkpoint byte size; restart numerical equivalence.

frozen_gates.cold_gain_5pct_vs_matched: candidate pooled cold MSE <=0.95*separate_relations pooled cold MSE (CRITICAL)
frozen_gates.cold_gain_5pct_vs_rehearsal: candidate pooled cold MSE <=0.95*rehearsal_ridge pooled cold MSE (CRITICAL)
frozen_gates.cold_gain_10pct_vs_other_conventional: candidate cold MSE <=0.90*min(full_elasticnet,rbf_kernel) pooled cold MSE
frozen_gates.seed_stability_2_of_3: candidate cold MSE strictly below separate_relations within >=2 of 3 independent seed cohorts (CRITICAL)
frozen_gates.all_families_no_more_than_10pct_worse: candidate cold MSE <=1.10*separate_relations cold MSE within each causal family
frozen_gates.historical_old_middle_retention: all 36 worlds candidate OLD and MIDDLE held predictions exactly identical to matched separate_relations readouts at max absolute difference <=1e-11
frozen_gates.cold_20pct_better_than_no_update: pooled candidate cold MSE <=0.80*no_update pooled cold MSE
frozen_gates.cold_20pct_better_than_shuffled: pooled candidate cold MSE <=0.80*shuffled_new pooled cold MSE
frozen_gates.new_context_no_more_than_10pct_worse: pooled candidate held-new MSE <=1.10*separate_relations held-new MSE
frozen_gates.cold_restart_all_pass: 36 fresh isolated Python process checks all 4 context readouts within 1e-11; verifier exit 0

classification.DEVELOPMENT_PROVISIONAL_GO: All 11 frozen gates PASS; source-free independent model refit and full fresh-process restart audit both PASS, exact source replay PASS. External synthetic provisional only, native SCIENTIFIC_PASS not implied.
classification.DEVELOPMENT_NO_GO: Any frozen scientific gate fails with valid prereg, complete model controls and independent checks; preserve outcome, do NOT tune or rerun consumed seeds.
classification.INVALID: Missing/late prereg, source hash changes, label leakage, split duplicates, absent strong conventional controls, independent audit failure, or incomplete primary receipts. Infrastructure errors separately classified.
classification.UNVERIFIED: If scoring, audit or custody not completed do not report a scientific pass or result.
classification.next_actions: No model/accepted-ref/loop promotion or native training; no extra primary seeds or unfrozen threshold adaptations. If external GO, propose separate native qualification, not automatic integration.

prior_disc: Two pre-freeze excluded seed pilots 999211 and 999227 of 3 worlds each passed 7,888 independent checks; candidate cold 0.231393 vs separate 0.236672 and candidate cold 0.268797 vs separate 0.351242. This is candidate-selection context, NOT confirmatory evidence.
provenance_security: No reused private user data, no credentials, no external paid API. Main, accepted research state and native Yggdrasil untouched.
